Southwest Iowa Renewable Energy
Farmers Fueling The Future
Who We Are
With a focus on sustainability, SIRE exemplifies agricultural innovation by producing high-quality, low-carbon ethanol and feed products. In fact, our upgrades have put our energy efficiency in the top 15% of similar plants - establishing us a leader in sustainable fuel now and for generations to come.
